'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You're just in time. My expectations were too high, I guess. Things are so brutal around here, and people still won't buy these shotguns. One guy even told me he would never buy this "janky movie prop". Unbelievable! We gotta show everybody that this gun is well worth the money. Let's put on a real show in Tarkov, so that everyone knows that my shotguns aren't just for movies!}}

==Objectives==
*Eliminate any 20 targets while using the MPS Auto Assault-12 shotgun

==Rewards==
* +39,900 [[EXP]]
* [[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 130,000 Roubles
** 136,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 149,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* Unlocks barter for [[MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 2 12ga automatic shotgun]] at [[Skier]] LL4
{{quote|Now we're talking... The orders are rolling in, so it's a total success! Here's your share, fair and square.}}
